key_concepts: Physical change alters shape, size, or state without forming a new substance
Chemical change forms a new substance with different properties
Melting, freezing, condensation, evaporation, sublimation, and deposition are changes of s
Crumpling and tearing paper are examples of physical change
Burning paper is an example of chemical change
Crushing sugar is a physical change
Heating sugar until it changes color is a chemical change
Mixing vinegar and baking soda produces a new substance and cannot be reversed
Chemical changes may release gases, smoke, or odor
Baking a cake, digesting food, rusting iron, and burning wood are chemical changes
